title: Arab West Report Interview Documentation Project: Sudan and Sudanese in Cairo 1994-1995
contributors: M.R. Sparks (Center for Intercultural Dialogue and Translation (CIDT))

contacts.name: C.  Hulsman
contacts.affiliation: Center for Intercultural Dialogue and Translation (CIDT)

descriptions: This dataset contains 14 recordings (7 items) on the subject of Sudan and Sudanese in Cairo 1994-1995.
The interviews are conducted in Dutch, English and Arabic. All summaries and metadata of interviews are provided in English.

relations.text: Thematic collection: Data from the Center for Intercultural Dialogue and Translation (CIDT) and Stichting Arab-West Foundation (AWF). DOI: 10.17026/dans-22k-22dc

data_sources: All interviews were conducted by Cornelis Hulsman, Drs., and unnamed members of the Egyptian Foreign Press Association.
